display_name: Phase1 source L_s receiver-crossfit agreement router
description: Train candidate selector on source L_s receiver folds using class-permutation-invariant predicted agreement, then score heldout receiver decisions.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CPU fixed predictor; separate CPU source L_s truth-last scorer

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Five fixed candidate predicted classes per source L_s record, equality pattern only; no new IQ inference
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Only legitimate source L_s truth after all predictions fixed; no U_s truth, V or test read
data.validation_ref: L_s source RX4 trained on RX6, RX6 trained on RX4, RX8 trained on RX4/6; all F previously saw source physical IDs

permissions.query_use: Legal source L_s labels are loaded together; each fold fits only other receivers labels, heldout receiver labels do not enter that fold fit or decision. No U_s truth, V, or target data.
permissions.claim_scope: Source L_s data previously used by ground F and/or prior views; not independent blind or target test

checkpoint.initialization: No neural IQ inference; fit agreement-pattern empirical candidate correctness from source train-fold L_s labels; DURA fixed candidate.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: All 1047 source prediction cohorts and common clean/raw/DURA/parent decisions must match before source truth
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed prior strength16, minimum pattern count8, margins 0/.03/.1; all three evaluated per heldout source receiver; no automatic target test or holdout-based model selection.

execution.launch_owner: Codex source agreement crossfit diagnostic owner
execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, no new IQ inference

execution.stop_rule: Stop for source provenance/role violations, output collision, nonfinite values or technical failures; do not retry without state reconciliation.

metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Three existing 1047-record source L_s fixed prediction artifacts
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Each receiver fold fits only other receivers L_s labels, even though legal L_s metadata are loaded together; heldout decisions are fixed before scoring. Router uses equality patterns, invariant to class renaming; oracle unavailable at deployment.

rows.purpose: measure deployable-style source receiver generalization from candidate agreement only
rows.seed_notes: Frozen direct mixture trained using 4096 other IDs, F previously used these source IDs; no updates.
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 1047 source L_s records, three receiver folds, three fixed margins
rows.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONPATH=/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261101-phase1-physical-rich-router-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261027-phase1-pamf-repl-shuffled-views-m16-r02-release /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261102-phase1-agreement-router-crossfit-s2026092701-r01-release/experiments/phase1_joint_mixture/agreement_source_crossfit.py predict --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --out /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261102-phase1-agreement-router-crossfit-s2026092701-r01 --commit 89b173c787ebf30d513ecfb3b4747348784d6d3d

notes: Three separate models use disjoint receiver folds; all legal L_s labels are loaded together but no heldout receiver label enters its own model fit or decision.
Same source L_s records and views previously explored and F was trained on source; not an independent test.
DURA is one fixed candidate; selector depends only on predicted-class equality, not class names or true labels at inference.
No U_s truth, V or target data.
